dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (III)
dialogues.text: "...Our family sent people to inform us of the search of... 'Alanara', or 'Nanorara'? And they asked us to act before the spy from the snowy land. Honestly, I don't understand what they meant..."

dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (III)
dialogues.text: "...but Siman, the daughter of the legendary Agha Farrokh, has rallied the tribe to offer a reward for this. That means this 'Ananana' must be extremely important. We need to get it first..."

dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (III)
dialogues.text: "...Lunja was so excited that she kept rattling about it all night, and thanks to that, we couldn't fall asleep either. Ugh, I'm so sleepy now..."
